positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Won intern hackathon by creating an integration to discover unusually cheap hotels for given dates, as part of a four-member multi-disciplinary team. Created a new, production-ready microservice for the project by integrating multiple existing machine learning APIs for predicting hotel pricing.
- Improved the consistency, accessibility, and personalization of TripAdvisor’s user experience as a full-stack engineer in the Core Experience Business Unit.
- Increased productivity on the product side by building a QA tool that surfaced tracking data from development environments on a concise user interface. Collaborated with analysts and project managers to design the UI according to critical needs.
- Created and maintained backend microservices for the TripAdvisor site, using modern Java code and GraphQL to facilitate a seamless API for client code.
- Bolstered the development of functional specifications for new health and safety features by investigating current safety systems in TripAdvisor software. Explored strategies for migrating existing technologies to a backend microservice.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Engineered and maintained software for Thomson Reuters’ Legal Professional Authority, an internal software system that stores,
manages, and provides access to the company’s most up-to-date data on legal professionals and their associated organizations.
- Streamlined the processing of scraped data by configuring auto-update mechanisms, effectively decreasing the cost of manual data vetting by offshore employees.
- Designed and implemented error handling functionality for the Legal Professional Authority user interface to improve error response and recovery during user sessions. Used Java Servlets, jQuery, and XHTML.
- Managed data cleanup, moderated user errors, and verified deployments as the designated support point person every fourth development cycle.
